talk.transcript: Today, I want to talk about the concept of ecological footprints. An ecological footprint measures the environmental impact of an individual, community, or organization in terms of the amount of land and water area required to produce the resources consumed and to absorb the waste generated. This concept helps us understand how our lifestyle choices affect the planet. For example, a person who frequently uses public transportation and eats a plant-based diet will have a smaller ecological footprint compared to someone who relies heavily on driving and consumes a lot of meat. By calculating our footprints, we can find ways to reduce them and lead more sustainable lives.

questions.q: What does an ecological footprint measure?
questions.explain: 生態足跡測量環境影響。

questions.q: How can someone reduce their ecological footprint?
questions.explain: 通過減少肉類消耗可以減少生態足跡。

questions.q: Why is understanding ecological footprints important?
options: To understand lifestyle impacts on the planet
questions.explain: 了解生態足跡的重要性在於理解生活方式對地球的影響。

questions.q: What is a lifestyle characteristic of someone with a smaller ecological footprint?
questions.explain: 較小生態足跡的人的生活特徵是使用公共交通。
